$comment: UpgradeBench v0 pilot (UPT-24): three held-out public repositories, each with a human's merged upgrade in the range of a verified pack. None is in any pack's ground-truth.json (bench/excluded.json). Committed before either arm ran. checks are the repository's own commands, run by bench/check.sh with lifecycle scripts off.

repos.note: npm, single package. The upgrade (merged in PR #22) changes 3 source files, a test and a script: z.string().uuid() to z.guid(), .strict() tool schemas, a _def walker rewritten for zod 4. Mostly behavior, little a compiler sees. The commit carries a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer.
repos.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml: build (lint, typecheck, test, build, test:e2e), btp-descriptors, docker; tool-surface.yml

repos.note: pnpm 10.2.0 workspace of 2 packages plus a nested frontend-vue project with its own lockfile. The upgrade (PR #70) changes 14 source files: subscriptions.cancel options, schedule phase iterations to duration, allowed_payment_method_types, billing mode, apiVersion basil to dahlia. dms-saas type-checks only after the interface package is built.
repos.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml: static (build, lint, typecheck, knip, check:exports), unit (vitest), frontend

checks.install: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && corepack pnpm --dir packages/dms-saas/frontend-vue install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
checks.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @antelopejs/interface-dms-saas build && corepack pnpm -r typecheck

repos.note: npm, single package (Vite). The upgrade is the merge of PR #1760 (scored against its first parent): react, react-dom and their types to 19, react-leaflet 4 to 5, MutableRefObject to RefObject, useRef arguments, useReducer generics, 11 source files.
repos.ci: .github/workflows/pull-request-build-external.yml: fork pull requests, npm ci, prettier check, vitest, build (tsc and vite)
